R821.note: Replaces token-controlled jku fetch with a hardcoded trusted JWKS endpoint plus issuer/audience validation; behavior preserved for legitimate tokens.

R822.note: Path.startsWith(Path) correctly closes the sibling-directory string-prefix bypass with no other behavior change.

R823.note: mathjs.evaluate() is an appropriate sandboxed replacement for eval() on a math expression; standard, disclosed fix.

R824.note: Correctly rejects negative offset before unsigned cast and uses subtraction-safe bounds checks; return semantics preserved.

R825.note: Narrows CSRF exemption to /api/webhooks/** exactly matching the stated design intent; restoring CSRF on the rest of /api/** is the intended fix, not a side effect.

R826.note: Allowlist approach is correct for an ORDER BY identifier, but the allowlist {Id,Name,Status,AccountId} omits "created_at", the controller's default when no ?sort= is supplied (CustomerSearchController.cs: sort ?? "created_at") -- every default request now throws, silently breaking the common case; write-up never mentions this.

R827.note: Adds getSessionIdentifier using req.session.id, a stable per-session value; closes cross-session token reuse without other behavior change.

R828.note: Adds getSessionIdentifier using req.session.userId, which requireSession already guarantees is set on every protected route; correct and grounded in the given code.

R829.note: Standard parameterized query via database/sql placeholders with matching argument order; no other behavior change.

R830.note: Saves clientId to a local before the call that frees req, removing the freed-pointer dereference at the exact reported sink with no other change.

R831.note: AES-256-GCM with random nonce replaces DES-CBC/static IV; key-length requirement and nonce-prefixed ciphertext format are inherent, disclosed consequences of the algorithm upgrade, not incidental side effects.

R832.note: calloc(count, sizeof) provides standard overflow-checked allocation; the loop overwrites every zeroed byte so calloc's extra zero-init has no observable effect.

R833.note: Argument-array exec() for both platform branches is the standard fix for this exact benchmark pattern; waitFor() and overall control flow preserved.

R834.note: Minimal off-by-one loop bound fix (i < n), exactly closes the reported OOB write with no other change.

R835.note: Fix only edits enqueue_completion/process_work_queue and leaves main() (same file, in scope) unchanged -- main() still calls handle_connection_reset() right after enqueue_completion(), which frees the shared Connection before process_work_queue dereferences ctx->conn->fd, so the exact reported UAF still fires, and the newly added connection_release(&ctx->conn) then double-frees it.

R836.note: Standard mysql2 placeholder parameterization; error handling and response shape unchanged.

R837.note: Replaces leaked error.message/stack with a generic message matching the app's own global-handler pattern; logging preserved.

R838.note: Character allowlist blocks traversal/stream-wrapper input outright, and realpath prefix check is redundant-but-harmless defense-in-depth since no path separators can reach it; legitimate plugin names unaffected.

R839.note: Adds SpaCsrfTokenRequestHandler to pair with the cookie repository, which is Spring Security's documented fix for exactly this raw-vs-BREACH-encoded token mismatch; resolves the described bug without weakening protection.

R840.note: Scopes listInvoices() via findByOwnerUsername(), mirroring the existing getInvoice() ownership pattern; no unrelated change.

R841.note: Validates true file bytes via python-magic against an image allowlist and uses the detected type for upload instead of trusting client input; restricting types is the fix itself, stated openly.

R842.note: crypto.randomBytes() is a correct CSPRNG replacement; resulting code format differs from Math.random()'s output but nothing downstream constrains that format.

R843.note: Moves to Jinja2 template variables with autoescaping instead of string concatenation; page structure and display behavior otherwise unchanged.

R844.note: Absolute-path containment check correctly appends the path separator before the prefix test, avoiding the sibling-directory bypass, and is placed before both the directory- and file-write paths.
